description: Search Marmiton and the Wikibooks Cookbook at once, and scale quantities. No API key.
name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-recipes

environmentVariables.description: Identify your own client. The project's own identifier is appended, so a site can always reach a human.
environmentVariables.name: RECIPES_USER_AGENT

environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between two requests to the same site. Default 1000, floor 500.
environmentVariables.name: RECIPES_MIN_INTERVAL_MS

environmentVariables.description: Deadline for one request to a site, in milliseconds. Default 20000.
environmentVariables.name: RECIPES_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Retries on rate limiting and transient failures. Default 3.
environmentVariables.name: RECIPES_MAX_RETRIES

environmentVariables.description: In-memory cache lifetime, in milliseconds. Default 900000. Set 0 to turn it off.
environmentVariables.name: RECIPES_CACHE_TTL_MS

environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
environmentVariables.name: RECIPES_LOG_LEVEL
